mapping_audit.baseline_policy: Full promoted 18.2 values; only explicit 18.2a deltas. Unmentioned star values and historical supplemental evidence are retained. Experience is owned by the integrating agent.

issues.name: 凯尔
issues.resolution: Explicit requested new values applied against observed baseline; fourth-star old-value discrepancy retained.

issues.name: 绯红印记树怪
issues.resolution: User clarified current base armor ignore as 15% and one/two-star formula as 15% + 30% AP. The earlier 20% + 25% AP announcement is superseded by this clarification. Unconfirmed high-star values remain historical.
Only base (one-star) attack damage changed; two/four-star scaling not extrapolated. Yi remains [60,93,139,209]; Cinderbrute remains [120,172,258,387].

issues.name: 黑荆棘
issues.resolution: Store explicit new coefficient as a semantic balance override; inherited text does not expose the tank sacrifice coefficient.

issues.name: 赏金猎人
issues.resolution: All six requested deltas retained as semantic overrides. No matching bounty task rows exist in inherited champions, traits, season mechanics or reward tables. Do not invent task IDs or merge the 12-to-7 gold change with the separate 12-gold kill task.
Condition stored on all three families and six source variants, with visible descriptions and typed source text synchronized. This overlay does not implement shop enforcement.

issues.name: 拉克丝
issues.resolution: All nine mapped elemental forms resolve to champion 5459; no separate numeric skill records exist to modify.

Pinned supplemental HTML has pre-existing conflicting skill values (including Kayle, Diana, Ahri, Blue Sentinel and Lux). Operations update canonical skills, exact effect blocks and attributes only; raw supplemental evidence and source hashes are not rewritten.
